description: This file defines a Java interface CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder, along with nested response and event factory interfaces, used to construct command responses and events related to the 'CreateThing' command within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for 'CreateThing' commands.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects, such as success or conflict error responses.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events, such as 'ThingCreated'.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a CreateThingResponse or ThingCreated event using command values.

methods.name: thingConflictError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating a conflict.
